description: The file defines the 'Footprint' class within the Goteo project, including properties, methods for retrieving and manipulating footprints, and use of multiple traits. It handles database interactions related to footprints, localization, and relationships with other models.

classes.name: Footprint
classes.description: Represents a footprint entity with properties, and methods to retrieve and manipulate footprint data, including localization and relationships with other models.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the fields that are localized for language support.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a footprint instance from the database by ID, optionally with language localization.

methods.name: getFromModelIds
methods.description: Fetches footprints associated with given model IDs across different relation models.

methods.name: getFromCategories
methods.description: Retrieves footprints linked to specified category IDs.

methods.name: getFromSdgs
methods.description: Retrieves footprints linked to specified SDG IDs.

methods.name: getFromSpheres
methods.description: Retrieves footprints linked to specified sphere IDs.

methods.name: getFromSocialCommitments
methods.description: Retrieves footprints linked to specified social commitments.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Lists footprints applying optional filters, pagination, and can return count.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the footprint's icon, optionally as an asset.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the footprint object to the database after validation.
